channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: ₹47,000 Crore Railway Development Push in Telangana: Kishan Reddy Highlights Major Infrastructure Projects
item.description: Union Minister Kishan Reddy says railway development works worth ₹47,984 crore are underway in Telangana, including modernization of stations and new rail corridors.

item.title: Telangana SSC Hall Ticket 2026: How to Download Class 10 Hall Ticket on WhatsApp
item.description: Telangana SSC Hall Ticket 2026 can now be downloaded through WhatsApp, official website and schools. Here’s how Class 10 students can get their hall tickets easily.

item.title: Hyderabad 36-Hour Water Supply Disruption on March 7–8: Areas Affected, Reason and What Residents Should Do
item.description: Hyderabad residents will face a 36-hour water supply disruption on March 7–8 due to maintenance at Manjira Phase-3 pumping station. Check affected areas and advisory.

item.title: 3 Months Ration Rice Distribution in Telangana April 2026: Centre Advises Advance Supply for Summer Relief
item.description: The 3 months ration rice distribution in Telangana April 2026 plan may allow beneficiaries to receive April–June rice quota in one visit to reduce heatwave hardship.

item.title: IAF confirms loss of two pilots in Sukhoi Su-30MKI Fighter aircraft crash, expresses condolences
item.description: The Indian Air Force (IAF) on Friday confirmed the loss of Squadron Leader Anuj and Flight Lieutenant Purvesh Duragkar, who sustained fatal injuries in the crash of a Sukhoi Su-30MKI fighter aircraft. The IAF also expressed its sincere condolences to the families of the deceased officers.

item.title: Andhra Police continue questioning Bihar IGP for second day in ex-MP’s torture case
item.description: Bihar Inspector General of Police, Sunil Kumar Naik appeared before Andhra Pradesh police for second consecutive day on Friday for questioning in the alleged custodial torture of former Member of Parliament K. Raghurama Krishna Raju.

item.title: ED raids multiple entities linked to Anil Ambani, Reliance Power: Sources
item.description: A team of approximately 15 specialised ED units initiated the searches in the early hours, focused on the registered offices and residential premises of people related to the power utility company, sources added.

item.title: LoP Gandhi expresses grief over death of two IAF pilots in Sukhoi Su-30MKI fighter aircraft crash
item.description: Leader of the Opposition (LoP) in the Lok Sabha, Rahul Gandhi, on Friday expressed deep sadness over the death of Indian Air Force (IAF) officers Squadron Leader Anuj and Flight Lieutenant Purvesh Duragkar in the crash of a Sukhoi Su-30MKI fighter aircraft.

item.title: Owaisi demands Modi govt’s statement on US Navy sinking Iranian ship
item.description: The All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) chief wanted to know if the United States were to repeat these against the two Iranian ships around, would the Modi government still act like ostriches with their heads in the sand.

item.title: CBSE cancels Class 10 exams in West Asia amid rising Iran-Israel tensions
item.description: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has cancelled Class 10 Board examinations in several West Asian countries amid escalating tensions in the region following the ongoing conflict involving Iran, Israel, and the United States, the Embassy of India in Muscat confirmed on Friday.
